info.name: ClearPostcode API
info.description:
UK postcode lookup, validation, autocomplete, reverse geocoding, distances and area data, on the ONS Postcode Directory and OS Open Names. v1 only ever grows: new endpoints and new fields, never a removed or renamed one. Anything breaking would be v2, announced at least 12 months ahead with Deprecation and Sunset headers.

Fields: postcode; status; outcode, incode, sector, district, area; introduced, terminated; replaced_by; user_type; location; country, region, county, local_authority, ward, parish; county_electoral_division; constituency; police_force, nhs_region, icb, sub_icb; national_park, built_up_area, travel_to_work_area; lsoa, msoa, output_area; rural_urban; area_classification; deprivation.

Set the apiKey collection variable to your key (free at https://clearpostcode.co.uk/developers). Most endpoints also work with it empty. Docs: https://clearpostcode.co.uk/developers/docs

header.description: Optional on keyless endpoints. cp_live_ (secret) or cp_pub_ (publishable).

query.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to return (postcode and status always come back).

request.description:
Everything about one postcode: status (live or terminated), coordinates with positional quality, and every area it sits in (country, region, county, council, ward, parish, constituency, police force, NHS board, census areas), plus rural-urban class and deprivation decile. A terminated postcode answers 200 with status "terminated", the month it ended and the nearest live postcode in replaced_by.

Billing: 1 lookup when found; not found is free. Works with publishable (browser) keys. Can be tried without a key (rate-limited per IP).

Billing: 1 lookup when found; not found is free

request.description:
Three answers in one: is the format valid, is it in the current edition (known), and is it live. Northern Ireland (BT) postcodes are checked by format only and come back with coverage "not_covered". New-build postcodes can take up to a quarter to reach the open data, so treat known: false as "check again", never as "wrong".

Billing: 1 lookup when known; otherwise free. Works with publishable (browser) keys. Can be tried without a key (rate-limited per IP).

Billing: 1 lookup when known; otherwise free
